name: Hitozuma Leotard 2 ~Akage no Bijo wa Inran Tsuma~
original_name: 人妻レオタード2～赤毛の美女は淫乱妻～
source:
Let's buy various leotards by using the one like a kind of money that is called RP and dress to married women. It buys of course, and the game progresses by the dressed leotard. The thing always changed while playing a game is possible. The dressed leotard can be reflected even in event CG. Not only default (usually) leotard but also a special leotard was prepared.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081206123719/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1002406]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
玩家可以使用一种名为RP、类似货币的点数购买各种紧身衣，再让已婚女性穿上。游戏会根据购买并穿上的紧身衣推进；游玩过程中也可以随时更换服装。所穿的紧身衣甚至会反映在事件CG中。除默认的普通紧身衣外，游戏还准备了特殊款式。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081206123719/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1002406]Eroge Shop[/url]]
